metadata.description: Self-hosted marketplace for the project-reviewer Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: project-reviewer
plugins.description: Qualitative multi-agent project review: project-level tech-stack-fit assessment with per-technology depth (primary) plus per-file 3-criteria findings (secondary) and an independent clickable architecture diagram with per-component scores, rendered as a self-contained HTML report. Reviews backend + AI files by default; frontend is opt-in. Each reviewed repo gets its own output folder. Does not build/run/test code.
